newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: YACHTING-Black Magic yachts sail as sponsors named.
newsitem.headline: YACHTING-Black Magic yachts sail as sponsors named.

text.p: New Zealand's two America's Cup-winning yachts sailed together on Auckland Harbour on Monday as Team New Zealand announced five sponsors for their cup defence, NZPA reports.
Making the announcement on board the Team New Zealand tender launch, Sir Peter Blake said the "family of five" sponsors were part of the team.
The sponsors are Lotto, Steinlager, Telecom NZ, TVNZ and Toyota NZ.
The Walt Disney company would also be part of the team, Blake said, although that company's name would not appear on the boat.
Their involvement would be in licensing and merchandising.
Today was the first time that NZL32 and NZL38, both dubbed Black Magic, had sailed together on New Zealand waters.
Designers and engineers joined the crew on board today in perfect sailing conditions of less than 10 knots.
Blake said the boats had been modified, although details of those changes would be kept under wraps.
He said quarter-sized models of the yachts had undergone testing in tanks in the United Kingdom.
Blake said Team New Zealand would be using a position-finding system, which gave accuracy to two centimetres, during their defence preparations.
The planned sailing on Friday had to be called off after Cyclone Drena hit Auckland.
